notes.title: Small update
notes.content: I have fixed bugs in the enemy AI and improved performance, as well as update UI.

notes.title: Hotfix 0.1
notes.content:
Faster loading times, decreased size of map to speed up gameplay, added Controls layout,
 added "How To Play" help menu.

notes.title: War Of The Titans release
notes.content:
I am a new Solo Dev. War Of The Titans was always a passion project for me, and to see it on the market is beyond anything I ever dreamt of. My goal is to add more content to the game over the first year of release, but most importantly I want to hear from players about what changes they want to see. For instance if you want more resource management or more survival mechanics etc..
Join our discord and let me know what you think
https://discord.gg/78bnvMz3
